datasets.name: 603b6bdd
queryLines:
SELECT
    source_entity,
    bronze_records,
    silver_records,
    quarantined_records,
    quarantine_rate,
    reconciled_flag,
    _gold_generated_at
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_reconciliation;

datasets.name: 865ba12a
queryLines:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT dq_rule) AS failed_rules,
    SUM(failure_count) AS total_rule_failures
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_data_quality_metrics
WHERE failure_count > 0;

datasets.name: 52da1028
queryLines:
SELECT
    dq_rule,
    SUM(failure_count) AS failure_count
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_data_quality_metrics
WHERE failure_count > 0
GROUP BY dq_rule
ORDER BY failure_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: 8e4fe4cb
queryLines:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN reconciled_flag = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reconciled_entities,
    COUNT(*) AS total_entities,
    SUM(CASE WHEN reconciled_flag = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreconciled_entities
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_reconciliation;

datasets.name: 9f0d42ae
queryLines:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_enrolled_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS enrolled_subjects,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_screen_failed_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_screened_flag), 0), 2
    ) AS screen_fail_rate_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_discontinued_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_enrolled_flag), 0), 2
    ) AS discontinuation_rate_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(completed_visits)
        / NULLIF(SUM(total_visits), 0), 2
    ) AS visit_completion_rate_pct,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN serious_ae_count > 0 THEN subject_id
    END) AS subjects_with_serious_ae,

    MAX(_gold_generated_at) AS last_gold_refresh

FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary;

datasets.name: 91b03c63
queryLines:
SELECT
    SUM(quarantined_records) * 1.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(bronze_records), 0) AS quarantine_rate
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_reconciliation;

datasets.name: 099bbc4b
queryLines:
SELECT
    enrollment_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_enrolled,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (
        ORDER BY enrollment_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_enrolled
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary
WHERE ever_enrolled_flag = 1
  AND enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY enrollment_date
ORDER BY enrollment_date;

datasets.name: 4a06ba1a
queryLines:
SELECT 'Screened' AS stage,
       SUM(ever_screened_flag) AS subjects,
       1 AS stage_order
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Enrolled',
       SUM(ever_enrolled_flag),
       2
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Randomized',
       SUM(ever_randomized_flag),
       3
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary

ORDER BY stage_order;

datasets.name: db5457c6
queryLines:
SELECT
    study_id,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_screened_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS screened,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_enrolled_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS enrolled,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_randomized_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS randomized,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_completed_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS completed,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_screen_failed_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_screened_flag), 0),
        1
    ) AS screen_fail_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_discontinued_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_enrolled_flag), 0),
        1
    ) AS discontinuation_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(completed_visits)
        / NULLIF(SUM(total_visits), 0),
        1
    ) AS visit_completion_pct,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN serious_ae_count > 0 THEN subject_id
    END) AS subjects_with_serious_ae

FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary

GROUP BY study_id
ORDER BY study_id;

datasets.name: 530d48c3
queryLines:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrollment_date) AS enrollment_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS monthly_enrollment
    FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary
    WHERE ever_enrolled_flag = 1
      AND enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrollment_date)
)

SELECT
    enrollment_month,
    monthly_enrollment,
    SUM(monthly_enrollment) OVER (
        ORDER BY enrollment_month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_enrollment
FROM monthly
ORDER BY enrollment_month;

datasets.name: aef35ee1
queryLines:
SELECT
    study_id,
    site_id,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ever_enrolled_flag = 1 THEN subject_id
    END) AS enrolled_subjects,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_screen_failed_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_screened_flag), 0),
        2
    ) AS screen_fail_rate_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(ever_discontinued_flag)
        / NULLIF(SUM(ever_enrolled_flag), 0),
        2
    ) AS discontinuation_rate_pct,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(completed_visits)
        / NULLIF(SUM(total_visits), 0),
        2
    ) AS visit_completion_rate_pct,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN serious_ae_count > 0 THEN subject_id
    END) AS subjects_with_serious_ae

FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary
GROUP BY study_id, site_id;

datasets.name: b0b2783d
queryLines:
SELECT
    subject_id,
    study_id,
    site_id,
    current_subject_status,
    days_on_study,
    total_visits,
    completed_visits,
    missed_visits,
    rescheduled_visits,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * completed_visits / NULLIF(total_visits, 0),
        2
    ) AS visit_completion_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * missed_visits / NULLIF(total_visits, 0),
        2
    ) AS missed_visit_pct,
    serious_ae_count,
    abnormal_lab_rate,
    days_since_last_visit
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_subject_summary;

datasets.name: 6346040a
queryLines:

datasets.name: 2829ba8a
queryLines:
SELECT
    study_id,
    site_id,
    lab_test_code,
    lab_test_name,
    standard_unit,
    total_results,
    subjects_tested,
    abnormal_count,
    subjects_with_abnormal,

datasets.name: 8c9f366c
queryLines:
SELECT
    visit_name,
    MIN(visit_number) AS visit_number,
    SUM(completed_visits) AS completed_visits,
    SUM(eligible_visits) AS eligible_visits,
    SUM(completed_visits) * 1.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(eligible_visits), 0) AS visit_completion_rate
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_visit_compliance
GROUP BY visit_name
ORDER BY visit_number;

datasets.name: c478888e
queryLines:
SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(missed_visits) AS missed_visits,
    SUM(eligible_visits) AS eligible_visits,
    SUM(missed_visits) * 1.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(eligible_visits), 0) AS missed_visit_rate
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_visit_compliance
GROUP BY site_id
ORDER BY missed_visit_rate DESC;

datasets.name: aa5528a7
47890edc
queryLines:
SELECT
    ae_severity,
    SUM(ae_events) AS ae_events,
    SUM(subjects_with_ae) AS subjects_with_ae
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_safety_metrics
WHERE ae_severity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ae_severity
ORDER BY CASE ae_severity
    WHEN 'MILD' THEN 1
    WHEN 'MODERATE' THEN 2
    WHEN 'SEVERE' THEN 3
    WHEN 'LIFE_THREATENING' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
END;

datasets.name: 7216826a
queryLines:
SELECT
    study_id,
    site_id,
    SUM(ae_events) AS serious_ae_events
FROM clinical_trial_intelligence.gold.gold_safety_metrics
WHERE serious_flag = 'YES'
GROUP BY study_id, site_id
ORDER BY serious_ae_events DESC;
